title: NIST SP 800-181 Rev. 1: Workforce Framework for Cybersecurity
notes: Defines the framework structure; component releases are maintained separately.

title: Occupations, Jobs, and Work Roles

title: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF)
version: 2022 framework; revision in progress at review time
notes: Overview of 12 representative professional profiles; ENISA states that the ECSF is being revised.

title: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework Role Profiles
notes: Primary role-profile publication covering missions, tasks, knowledge, skills, and alternative titles.

title: Cyber Career Pathways Tool
version: tool data: NICE Components 2.0.0 (stated on page)
notes: Useful for comparing Work Roles and related TKS. Tool data lags the current NICE 2.2.0 Components; some visits returned HTTP 403.

title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
notes: Risk management outcomes and six functions; this is not a job-title taxonomy.

title: Secure Software Development Framework
notes: Reference for secure software development practices and software supply chain work.

title: Zero Trust Architecture
notes: Architecture and access-control approach, not a standalone product category.

title: OWASP Top 10:2025
notes: Web application security risk awareness document; apply to appropriate technology context.

title: OWASP API Security Top 10
notes: API-specific security risk list.

title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
notes: Topic-specific secure implementation guidance; cite the individual cheat sheet where possible.

title: MITRE ATT&CK
notes: Adversary tactics and techniques; cite specific techniques for technical claims.

title: Common Weakness Enumeration
notes: Software and hardware weakness taxonomy; distinguish weakness from a specific CVE.

title: National Vulnerability Database
notes: Vulnerability records and enrichment; the home page loaded but automated text extraction returned no body, so no database totals are asserted.

title: Cloud Native Computing Foundation
notes: Entry point for cloud native projects; cite a project or specification page for technical claims.

title: Kubernetes Documentation
notes: Official platform documentation; individual pages should be checked against the version selector.

title: AWS Security Documentation
notes: AWS security documentation hub; cite service-level docs for product behavior.

title: Microsoft Security documentation
notes: Security documentation hub, including Microsoft security products and identity resources.

title: Google Cloud Security
notes: Official security overview; use Google Cloud product documentation for precise technical details.

title: OWASP Gen AI Security Project
notes: Entry point for generative AI and LLM application security resources.
